function.name: cut_card
function.description: Create a debate card from an article. Provide the claim and a public article URL, or exact article text already read. To choose the passage yourself without another model call, also supply markdownContent: an exact contiguous quote with **spoken words** bolded. Returns an importable card. Your tool runner sends these arguments to Evidex POST /api/cards and adds its private bearer token.

link.description: Public HTTP(S) article URL. Optional when sourceText is present.

sourceText.description: Exact article text, when already available or server fetching failed.

citation.description: Author/publication and date, copied from the article if available.

markdownContent.description: Optional finished excerpt with paired **bold** highlight markers. Omit to let Evidex select it.
